svg.title: RoomTour: Assignment 2 Part 2 early chatbot mockup
svg.desc: Five alternative pre-implementation states: normal input, loading, grounded answer, no match or insufficient data, and error. Illustrative fixture data only. No working chatbot or model calls.
svg.text: R
RoomTour
ASSIGNMENT 2 PART 2 · EARLY CHATBOT DESIGN
Existing RoomTour sections stay in place
Demo user · CSV stays / booking history · ZIP search · Local hotel cards · Synchronized Leaflet map
Five alternate states of the planned Hotel questions panel
Static mockup before implementation. All hotel names and answers below are illustrative fixtures.
01 · Normal / input state
Ready · Ask about locally saved hotel data.
Hotel question
e.g. Which saved hotels in ZIP 16802 have rooms on October 10?
Send
Conversation / answer area
Answers use local records. Demo rates and room counts are fictional; this assistant cannot book stays.
02 · Loading state
Searching local data · Send is disabled while a request is pending.
Hotel question
Which saved hotels in ZIP 16802 have rooms on October 10, 2026?
Sending…
You: Which saved hotels in ZIP 16802 have rooms on October 10, 2026?
Checking local hotel records and preparing an answer…
03 · Grounded answer state
Answer based on retrieved local rows · Example fixture only.
Hotel question
Which saved hotels in ZIP 16802 have rooms on October 10, 2026?
Send
You: Which saved hotels in ZIP 16802 have rooms on October 10, 2026?
Assistant: The retrieved rows contain one matching saved hotel: Example Inn.
For October 10, 2026, its stored demo rate is $100.00/night with 20 rooms available.
Simulated classroom data — not a live price, real availability or booking guarantee.
Basis: 1 illustrative matching row · ZIP 16802 · 2026-10-10 · Saved hotels only; area coverage is incomplete.
04 · No-match / insufficient-data state
Insufficient local data · An empty result is not a service error.
Hotel question
What rooms are available in ZIP 16802 on November 1, 2026?
Send
You: What rooms are available in ZIP 16802 on November 1, 2026?
Assistant: No matching saved nightly rows were found for that date.
I cannot confirm prices or room counts. Try a date covered by your saved records.
No matching rows does not mean no hotels or rooms exist. Missing fields must also be described as unknown.
05 · Error state
Request failed · Keep the question and allow a later retry.
Hotel question
Which saved hotels in ZIP 16802 have rooms on October 10, 2026?
Send
The hotel assistant is temporarily unavailable. Your question is still here; please retry later.
No answer or hotel-data change is implied by this error.
Blocked-query variant: “I could not safely process that question. Please rephrase it as a hotel-data question.”
Design notes
Use labelled fields, native buttons, visible focus, status/alert announcements, and wrapping controls on narrow screens.
Backend validates read-only SQL; only backend code retrieves SQLite rows. The LLM never accesses SQLite directly.
Provider: free Nemotron via OpenRouter; class configuration and current limits will be rechecked. No model ID fixed here.
